comments.body: The PR adding the option is ~4 months old so some other change must be the cause. https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/pull/475107
Yes, it is 4 months old, though it was only merged last week, and only present in nixos-unstable for a few days. So it is likely the cause of this issue.

I think you have to disable the nixos option, as it actually conflicts with itself due to this line:
https://github.com/NixOS/nixpkgs/blob/nixos-unstable/nixos/modules/services/desktops/blueman.nix#L32
(the package contains a user unit with the same name)
@BulbaWarrior is correct about the error, issue updated and closing here. The bug is entirely in nixpkgs.

issue.body:
### Are you following the right branch?

- [x] My Nixpkgs and Home Manager versions are in sync

### Is there an existing issue for this?

- [x] I have searched the existing issues

### Issue description

Enabling `services.blueman` in nixos now adds a default `true` option to add the applet in nixos unstable; see [services.blueman.withApplet](https://search.nixos.org/options?channel=unstable&include_modular_service_options=1&include_nixos_options=1&query=blueman&show=option:services.blueman.withApplet). This creates logs like the following

```
systemd[8262]: blueman-applet.service: Service has more than one ExecStart= setting, which is only allowed for Type=oneshot services. Refusing.
systemd[8262]: blueman-applet.service: Cannot add dependency job, ignoring: Unit blueman-applet.service has a bad unit file setting.
```

Manually setting `services.blueman.withApplet` in nixos to false resolves the error.

_No response_
